svg.title: Lumen reflections: trace radiance (valid tiles only)
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen reflections: trace radiance (valid tiles only) graph 0001 | TraceVoxels pass | signed hit-distance validity | scale 0.3329 valid radiance (shared tonemap) unused trace tile (hit=+0, radiance is not a measurement) INVALID_LIGHTING sentinel (65024,65024,64512) valid zero radiance non-finite TraceHit is encoded by LumenReflectionCommon.ush:89-99: EncodeRayDistance = HitDistance * (-1 if hit else +1); negative = hit, positive = miss, +0 = cleared/unused. Unused tiles are not radiance=0. The trace texture is a 1280x888 array slice 0; the figure is the exact 1280x720 view rect. The sentinel triple is the source INVALID_LIGHTING from StochasticLightingCommon.ush:189-193, not a guessed threshold. This is pre-resolve trace radiance; valid zero and unused zero are rendered differently (black vs navy).

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
